executiveSummary: The Authority remains operationally ready for the 2026 hurricane season, with no identified threats to overall system integrity. Q3 field inspections are complete, all PCCP stations and complex structures remain mission ready, and routine maintenance continues without readiness impacts. As Hurricane Isaias approaches the central Gulf Coast, staff are actively monitoring weather and surge forecasts and implementing system closures and other operational measures as conditions require.
maintenanceActivities: Routine levee, floodwall, floodgate, valve, facility, and equipment maintenance continued with no impacts to system readiness.
Annual floodgate inspections remain up to date; Q4 valve inspections and exercises underway.
Field safety checks, required training, facility preparation, and seasonal readiness activities continue during hurricane season.
Facility repairs, warehouse system maintenance, and support infrastructure improvements remain ongoing.
Levee turf maintenance is slightly behind due to recent rain but catching up as weather conditions improve; no readiness impacts reported.
